items.title: Account switching
items.text: Trakt activity, profiles and upcoming episode dismissals stay with your account.

items.title: Playback preferences
items.text: Subtitle requests follow the current title. Forced subtitles and per-show audio choices work across more sources.

items.title: Discover and search
items.text: Browse longer catalogs and see available search results while slower sources respond.

items.title: Film collections
items.text: Collection pages recover from delayed title lookups and finish loading when a source is unavailable.
